howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能访问 golden_chat_topics 的 Discord 聊天记录（3条消息、2位用户、#help频道），分设置、排障、一般讨论三块查找，返回过往的解决方案与资源。
howto.when: 当用户要求测试 golden_chat_topics golden build，或需要查询该聊天记录中的设置、排障、一般讨论等话题时触发。

say.text: 从 golden_chat_topics 聊天记录里，设置部分有哪些内容？
say.note: 会返回设置板块的参考文件内容。

say.text: 这个聊天里讨论过哪些故障排查步骤？
say.note: 会读取 troubleshooting 参考文件。

say.text: 把 #help 频道里关于一般讨论的消息总结一下。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can access the golden_chat_topics Discord chat history (3 messages, 2 users, in #help), organized into Setup, Troubleshooting, and General Discussion sections, to retrieve past solutions and resources.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to test the golden_chat_topics golden build, or needs to look up setup, troubleshooting, or general discussion content from that chat history.

say_en.text: From the golden_chat_topics chat history, what's in the setup section?
What troubleshooting steps were discussed in this chat?
Summarize the general discussion messages in #help.
